templates.argument: theta = 2 pi / P with P = {P} > 2 lies in (0, pi), so sin(theta) != 0. If s_n = sin(theta n + phi) -> l, then c_n = cos(theta n + phi) = (s_{n+1} - s_n cos theta) / sin theta -> m, and s_{n+1} = s_n cos theta + c_n sin theta, c_{n+1} = c_n cos theta - s_n sin theta give m (1 - cos theta) = -l sin theta and m sin theta = l (1 - cos theta), whence l = m = 0 (the determinant is 2 - 2 cos theta > 0), contradicting s_n^2 + c_n^2 = 1: no limit; |x_n - c| <= amp, so bounded (Hardy Sec. 62); the row is the base row times 0.001 > 0
templates.reviewer: Codex blind_review (fresh context under the build loop, independent of the builder; evidence out/r3-0r/blind-review-round3.md); recorded by Claude DevBox under RULING R30R-4
